title: Review external source
purpose: Independently compare the entered observation, units, limits, dilution, qualifiers and provenance against the stored external report PDF before accepting or rejecting the latest source.
summary: Check the entered external result against its source PDF, then accept or reject it. Someone other than the person who entered it must review it.

tasks.title: Review the result
steps: Open the source PDF and compare the result, unit, limit, dilution, qualifiers and identity.
Choose the [[Decision]] and explain it in [[Note]].

tasks.title: Handle a mistake you find
steps: Reject the source with a note. The analyst then enters a corrected version for review.

good_to_know: You cannot review a source you entered yourself, even as an administrator.
A decision cannot be edited. A correction creates a new version to review.
Unit differs means the report uses another unit. Accepting does not convert it.
Accepting a source is not internal QC approval, and it does not issue a report.

items.label: Exact reported result
items.description: Original reported text and unit; ND is preserved as non-detect rather than numeric zero.

items.label: Catalog unit
items.description: The unit of the requested catalog test, frozen with the source. An external source is transcribed exactly, so its reported unit can differ. When it does, this row shows Unit differs with the reported unit. The source is still recorded, reviewed and reported in the unit as supplied, and nothing is converted.

items.label: Reporting limit / dilution
items.description: Exact applied reporting limit in the reported unit and the external dilution; these are source facts, not catalog defaults.

items.label: External method and version
items.description: Method/version transcribed from the external report, which may differ from the catalog request.

items.label: External analyst / analysis time
items.description: Reported analyst and analysis start in laboratory local time.

items.label: External laboratory / sample ID
items.description: Frozen source identity, including actual external sample ID; not merely an ID tentatively known at dispatch.

items.label: External report reference
items.description: Reference identifying the supplied source report.

items.label: Entered by
items.description: Local transcription actor and entry timestamp, separate from the external analyst.

items.label: Correction reason / source note
items.description: Reason for a new version or Initial external source entry when the first has no note.

items.label: Source PDF
items.description: Download staff-only source opens the exact attachment for this version. Size and SHA-256 identify stored bytes. The download verifies size/hash and refuses a corrupt file with a contact-the-laboratory error; it is unavailable to portal accounts.

items.label: Source review
items.description: Awaiting independent source review, or Accepted source/Rejected source with reviewer, time and note. Source acceptance is separate from internal analytical/QC approval.

items.label: Decision
items.description: Required Accepted source or Rejected source. Acceptance is external source acceptance and does not claim internal batch/QC approval or issue a report. When the reported unit differs from the catalog unit, a Unit differs warning naming both units appears directly above this field and is announced with it. Compare the unit with the source PDF before deciding; accepting does not convert it.

items.label: Note
items.description: Required explanation of the source review, at most 4000 characters.

items.label: Review external source
items.description: Reviewers and administrators record actor/time/decision/note and audit, then return to the subcontract. The source must still be the latest, have no decision and belong to an active dispatch. The entry author cannot review it, even with reviewer/admin role. A decision cannot be edited; a corrected source creates another version for review. When one of these conditions already fails as the page opens, the page shows the reason and a link back to the subcontract instead of the form. The server checks the same conditions again when the review is saved.

sections.title: Saving and concurrency
paragraphs: Validation errors keep submitted text on the form. A concurrent subcontract change refuses saving; reload and review its current source history before resubmitting. Cancel returns to the subcontract without changing it. Cancelled dispatches cannot receive source entry/review or further cancellation.
